name: @slu/web-shell
description: Renderer-neutral web game shell with composable genre frames and reusable game modules.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:base && npm run verify:consumers && npm run check:examples && npm run budget
scripts.check:examples: node --check examples/companion-dungeon/server.mjs && node --check examples/companion-dungeon/host.js && node --check examples/companion-dungeon/phone.js
scripts.certify:web: npm run verify && node tools/slu-certify.mjs web
scripts.certify:mobile: npm run verify && node tools/slu-certify.mjs mobile
scripts.certify:controller: npm run verify && node tools/slu-certify.mjs controller
scripts.certify:release: npm run verify && node tools/slu-certify.mjs release
